note: Detail shelves means organize product, discard all possible boxes, and wipe the shelves.

AM: Back dock detailed — cleaned, organized and sprayed off
Clean out fry freezer and restock
PM: Dishes pulled out of the expo window, and window detailed

AM: Wall detail — under and behind the ice machine
Wall detail — dish area and the equipment side of the line
Detail floors and FRP wall in dry storage and the hallway
PM: All tables and bun drawer detailed

AM: Freezer floor swept and cleaned — use antifreeze on the freezer floor
Detail entire dish area (machine / walls / floor / pipes)
PM: All drains, floor fans and trash cans detailed with bleach

AM: Detail prep equipment shelves (chemical shelves included)
All prep tables detailed (tops / shelves / legs)
PM: Empty and detail all setup coolers on the line & stand-up freezer (make sure all baskets are cleaned)

AM: Speed racks taken out back and sprayed off
PM: Air vents and surrounding tiles wiped down
All stainless on the front of equipment detailed — front of fryers, front of grill, etc.
All sinks cleaned / bleached (prep, hand, 3-compartment and dish sinks)

monthly.title: Ice machine
AM: Turn off first thing and clean outside of machine
PM: Burn ice and clean inside the machine with the hose

monthly.title: Flour bins
PM: Rotate and clean all flour bins

monthly.title: Speed racks
AM: Detail all speed racks — take them out back, spray them with grease strip, let that sit about 5 minutes, then spray off with hot water
